Question Choices: A group of 4 is selected from 6 women and 5 men. How many groups contain exactly 2 women?
Solution: Choose the required number from each disjoint category, then multiply the combination counts. To obtain exactly the specified count from one category, all remaining items must come from its complement. Here binomial(6,2)*binomial(5,2) = 150.

Question Choices: A committee has a president and three ordinary members. Which position has a distinct role, unlike the interchangeable ordinary members?
Hints: The president has a distinct role.|Ordinary committee seats are interchangeable.
Solution: A president has a distinct role; the ordinary members have interchangeable roles. With n eligible people, choose the president in n ways and then three ordinary members in C(n-1,3) ways. Equivalently choose all four members and then select their president: 4C(n,4). The president has the distinct role. For n people the count is n*C(n-1,3)=4*C(n,4); it is not an ordering of the three ordinary members.
